empty_state.title: No APIs in this namespace yet
empty_state.description: A namespace is a list of approved APIs, shared through workspaces. Members can request credentials to use them, and managers approve, scope, and revoke access.

help_modal.title: Add APIs to this namespace
help_modal.description: Add the APIs you want to make available in this namespace. Once a manager approves, members can request credentials to use them.
help_modal.step_2: Search for and select the APIs you want to make available. APIs are shared through workspaces, so you'll add a workspace.
help_modal.step_3: Add a note and send the request to the Namespace Manager.
help_modal.step_4: The manager approves and connects each secret the APIs use (passwords, tokens in their environments) to a vault reference (a pointer to the real secret).
help_modal.step_5: The APIs appear here, and members can request credentials to use them.

empty_state.title: No vault references yet
empty_state.description: Vault references let you use secrets from your vault (HashiCorp, AWS Secrets Manager, etc.) without storing them in Postman. The value stays in your vault and resolves at runtime.

toast.create_error: Couldn't create vault reference. Please try again.
